brief: Clear bird nesting material packed into the upper ventilation grille before other remedial activity, as clearance work takes precedence over other remediation ahead of a heat event [SOP-011]. Attend to work order WO-3182 for the cooling controller, which remains open from last season, as forced cooling is the highest priority among outstanding work items [SOP-016]. Address the conservator level low and the scale build-up across the lower third of the radiator bank [SOP-016].
